name: Classifarr
description: Classify movie and TV requests into the right Radarr or Sonarr library using policy rules and optional AI. Works with Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Includes PostgreSQL in one container; no external database is required. Music is not supported. Configure connections and API keys in the WebUI.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Optional media root for file verification and moves. Use this OR separate Movies/TV paths. Leave blank if unused.

paths.name: Movies Path
paths.description: Optional separate movie folder instead of a unified media root. Leave blank if unused.

paths.name: TV Path
paths.description: Optional separate TV folder instead of a unified media root. Leave blank if unused.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: The environment the app is running in

variables.name: Task Queue Retention
variables.description: How long completed tasks are retained before auto-cleanup

variables.name: pgvector Runtime Staging
variables.description: Runtime pgvector staging is opportunistic: use AVX/AVX2 when the PostgreSQL runtime mount permits it, otherwise fall back to generic.

variables.name: Runtime Mode
variables.description: Restart-selected operating mode. Restore mode disables workers and ordinary API operations; restart in normal mode only after verified recovery.

variables.name: Schema Maintenance
variables.description: Schema maintenance. Keep startup for the embedded Docker deployment. External is a staged non-embedded runtime boundary, NOT a complete credential cutover.
